Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 90: December 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #90 shipped to subscribers in November 2008 (bearing the cover date of December 2008 for Issue 90). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #90 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable media, and exclusive previews:

Tomb Raider: Underworld (action-adventure)
Sonic Unleashed (platformer)
Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts (vehicle construction action-adventure)
Legend of Spyro: Dawn of the Dragon (action-adventure)
Portal: Still Alive (Xbox Live Arcade expanded puzzle-platformer)
Age of Booty (Xbox Live Arcade real-time strategy)
Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix (Xbox Live Arcade fighting game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics and dashboard themes, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Prince of Persia, Skate 2, and Resident Evil 5, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
